extras.units: RAM and disk are quoted in the vendor's own decimal GB, not GiB. The ram_gib and disk_gib keys carry the vendor's number unconverted, so where a vendor writes 30 GB the key holds 30 and the true value is about 27.9 GiB. No conversion was performed.

free_tier.stated: Community (free): small compute only. 2 GB / 4 GB / 8 GB RAM profiles at $0/hr. No storage allocation published; there is no user-writable persistent disk, only data connections.

egress.terms: No published meter; the model is 'bring your own warehouse', so bytes never live with Hex.

record.tooling: Hex API + MCP server; data comes from connected warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Postgres), not from Hex storage.
record.chaining: None. Hex is a query layer. Whatever storage you use, you must already own.
record.limits_note: Free = 'Small compute' (8 GB max); 5 published apps on Professional; the free tier is a trial of the paid product in practice.
record.reliability_note: Not a storage provider in any sense. Recorded to close the branch.
